verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਰਾਜੇ ਹਰੀਚੰਦ ਘਰਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੁ ਤਾਰਾ ਲੋਚਨ ਰਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: sukh raaje hareecha(n)dh ghar naar su taaraa lochan raanee|

en.bdb: King HariChand had a queen with beautiful eyes, Tara, who had made his home the abode of comforts.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਾਵਦੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਾਇ ਸੁਣੈ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat mil gaavadhe raatee jai sunai gurbaanee|

en.bdb: At night she would go to the place where in the form of holy congregation, would recite the holy hymns.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਿਛੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਜਾਗਿਆ ਅਧੀ ਰਾਤਿ ਨਿਖੰਡਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: pichhai raajaa jaagiaa adhee raat nikha(n)dd vihaanee|

en.bdb: After she had left, the King awoke in the middle of the night and realised she had gone.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਣੀ ਦਿਸਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਮਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਰਤਿ ਗਈ ਹੈਰਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: raanee dhis na aaviee man vich varat giee hairaanee|

en.bdb: He could not find the Queen anywhere and his heart filled with astonishment

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰਤੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਉਠਿ ਕੈ ਚਲਿਆ ਪਿਛੈ ਤਰਲ ਜੁਆਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: horat raatee uTh kai chaliaa pichhai taral juaanee|

en.bdb: The following night he followed the young queen.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਣੀ ਪਹੁਤੀ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਰਾਜੇ ਖੜੀ ਖੜਾਉ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: raanee pahutee sa(n)gatee raaje khaRee khaRaau neesaanee|

en.bdb: The queen reached the holy congregation and the King lifted one of her sandals from there (so that he could prove the infidelity of the queen).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਜੋੜੀ ਜੁੜੀ ਖੜਾਉ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat aaraadhiaa joRee juRee khaRaau puraanee|

en.bdb: When about to go, the queen concentrated upon the holy congregation and the one sandal became a pair.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੇ ਡਿਠਾ ਚਲਿਤੁ ਇਹੁ ਏਹ ਖੜਾਵ ਹੈ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: raaje ddiThaa chalit ih eh khaRaav hai choj viddaanee|

en.bdb: The king upheld this feat and realized that there her matching sandal was a miracle.
I am sacrifice unto the holy congregation.
